scripts.dev: docker compose ps -q --status running postgres | grep -q . || { docker compose up -d --wait && trap "docker compose down" EXIT && trap "exit 130" INT TERM; } && drizzle-kit migrate && next dev
scripts.test: docker compose ps -q --status running postgres | grep -q . || { docker compose up -d --wait && trap "docker compose down" EXIT && trap "exit 130" INT TERM; } && next build && node --test --test-reporter=spec tests/integration/*.test.ts
scripts.check: prettier --check . && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && test $(wc -l < AGENTS.md) -lt 200 && npm test
